basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast who recently discovered the world of video encoding and digital storage. Based in Seattle, I work as a junior software developer by day and explore forums and subreddits by night. My interests include video games, tech gadgets, and learning about data hoarding. In a relationship with my high school sweetheart, and we both enjoy binge-watching shows on weekends. Online mostly during late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of video encoding from online courses and YouTube tutorials. My knowledge is mostly self-taught and I'm still learning the ropes. My software development background helps me grasp technical concepts, but I'm still new to the intricacies of codecs and data storage.
